windows.setup: Extract the ZIP, then run Install Gate Desk.cmd once. Open the new Gate Desk desktop shortcut. Python, dependencies and the experimental bag model are included.
windows.description: Local installation and launcher checks passed. A different clean PC, physical phones and factory counting still need testing. This is not a final factory release.

macos.setup: Extract the ZIP. In Terminal, open its folder and run sh "./Check This Mac.command". Python, dependencies and the experimental bag model are included. This checks compatibility; it does not install the app.
macos.description: Apple-silicon Mac only. Dependencies require macOS 14 or later; actual Mac support, installation, model execution and phone TLS remain unverified. Not a factory installer.
